title: Aligning feature-mapping designs to given density fields, first and second order
summary: Feature-mapping methods represent structural designs by explicit geometric primitives on fixed analysis grids, an interpretable and parametric alternative to the density fields of density-based topology optimization (SIMP). In contrast to SIMP, however, feature-mapping optimization is sensitive to the initial design. We present a gradient-based approach to align a feature-mapping configuration to a given (pseudo) density field, e.g., to initialize a subsequent feature-mapping optimization.
